name: forum
title: Forum
summary: People post text and links to communities, comment in threads, vote posts up or down (hot, new, top), mention each other, and moderators pin, lock and remove; every post is screened and held posts wait for review.

env.name: FORUM_POST_MAX_CHARS
env.doc: Longest post text accepted, in characters (Markdown included).

env.name: FORUM_VOTE_MIN_AGE
env.doc: How old an account must be before it can vote (e.g. 24h for a public forum); 0s lets everyone vote.

env.name: FORUM_KARMA_MIN_AGE
env.doc: Votes from accounts younger than this move scores but don't count toward the author's karma.

wire.insert: import { forumAdminNav, forumHomeTile, forumNav, forumNewPostAction } from "./forum/registry";

stitch: Decide the communities: create them in Admin → Forum, or from app code call forum.EnsureCommunity(ctx, tx, forum.CommunitySpec{RefKind, RefID, Title, Description}) when one of your objects is created (one community per product, place or event). Write each community's description: screening uses it to judge what's off-topic.
Name community moderators (Admin → Forum → a community → Moderators); staff moderate every community and work held posts and reports in Admin → Moderation.

Decide FORUM_VOTE_MIN_AGE (24h for a public forum) and FORUM_KARMA_MIN_AGE, and tune moderation's screening (MODERATION_BRAND_DOMAINS, MODERATION_LINK_DENYLIST, MODERATION_STRIKE_LIMITS, the optional decision model).
Place the entry: the nav item, home tile and ⌘K action ship on web, a Home row on mobile; move them or add a tab in the registries if the forum is central.
Optional: label posts with your own facts through forum.SetLabeler (from an init() in backend/internal/api/stitch_forum.go) and name the labels in FORUM_LABELS (packages/shared/src/forum/types.ts).
Add the forum to the privacy policy and store data-safety forms: posts, comments, votes and mentions people make; post titles appear in push notifications.
